title: Program name is missing in Cloud Mode after creating a program in Network mode
description: When a program is created in Network mode and then the user switches to Cloud Mode, the name of the created program is not visible in the program list. This issue is observed after successfully creating a program and saving it.
steps: Navigate to the "+ CREATE SCHEDULE" section.
Configure the program details, including selecting days of the week, event timing (Sunset), choosing groups (All Lights), and setting intensity.
Tap on the "Done" button to finish configuring the lighting event.
Confirm saving without an "Off Event" by tapping "YES".
Confirm saving without a "Special Event" by tapping "NO".
Observe that the created program, "Program A", is displayed with its schedule.
Navigate to the main menu or settings.
Tap on "SIGN IN TO LUXOR CLOUD".
Enter valid email and password credentials.
Observe the loading indicator "Connecting to Luxor Cloud".
Tap on the "A Wizard" site from the "SITE LIST".
Observe the "Processing your request" loading indicator.
Navigate back to the "+ CREATE SCHEDULE" section.
actual: The created program name is missing from the program list when viewed in Cloud Mode.
expected: The created program name should be visible in the program list in Cloud Mode.
